generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder send

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for these costs
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all the Tenders without assigning any reasons
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement Portal
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders

As per Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 1.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner other wise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class IV and above Registration
To qualify for award of this contract, each tender should give all details and documents as per K.W-1 and Work should be carried out as per K/W-1 STD attached with tender
The period of completion for work is 3 Months & the eligible contractor should maintain the Road Pot Hole free for ONE YEAR from the date of issue of Work order
Contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF Contribution rules and any modifications there of before and after execution of agreement
The FSD & Unbalanced Amount payable at the time of executing agreement, will be refunded only after successful completion of Defect Liability Period i.e., One Year from date of issue of work order
Contractors has to submit their labour EPF details with every Running Bill

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per govt Circular No:FD 417 Exp-12/2024, Banglore Dtd:09.08.2024 and prevailing GST (18% of amount put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lumpsum in sanctioned estimate. Therefore amount put to tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. But the itemwise rates do not include GST. Hence GST will be paid separately for the Executed amount accordingly.
The GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The Government and the Contractor have to abide to any increase or decrease in GST during agreement period
Contractors has to upload the E P F Registration Certificate
Contractor Shall comply with the Environment Protection Act 1986 and the Rules made there under
Contractors are responsible for ensuring Safety and also whole & Sole responsibility for any injury or risk factors of workers

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured according to ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS ISO 14001:2015) & QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (QMS ISO 9001:2015) Policies, so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing public/ private properties which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.

Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.
Successful bidder has to furnish 0.1% of award contract amount as insurance during entering in to agreement.

itemList.description: Removing white or colour wash by scrapping and sand papering and pre- paring the surface smooth including necessary repairs to scratches etc. complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Wall  painting  with  plastic  emulsion  paint  of  approved  brand  and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade:  One  coats  on  old  work  as  per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Manual Means -
Earth work in surface excavation for stripping, seating of bund, Road way by manual means for lowering & levelling the ground   for all   works other than foundation & depth in Ordinary rock and soft rock upto 300mm depth as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, barricading, caution lights,   including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated stuff or sorting &   stacking the selected   stuff for reuse in a radius of    50  m  and  lift  upto  1.5  m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage&  other appurtenances required to complete the work. ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.description: Cast in Situ Cement Concrete M 20 Kerb with Channel - Construction  of  cement  concrete  kerb  with  channel  with  top and bottom width 115 and 165 mm respectively, 250 mm high in M 20 grade PCC on M10 grade foundation 150 mm thick, kerb channel 300 mm wide, 50 mm thick in PCC M20 grade, sloped towards the kerb, kerb stone with channel laid with kerb laying machine,  foundation  concrete  laid  manually,  all  complete  as per clause 409 - PCC M20 grade for kerb Cast in Situ ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.
